title: Field mapping
description: Build nested objects from upstream values

fields.label: Target fields
fields.hint: Targets support nested paths such as user.name. Conflicting parent and child paths fail.

title: Select fields
description: Keep, remove, or rename object fields

fields.label: Field path
fields.hint: Use dot paths for nested fields. Use JSON Pointer for field names containing dots.

title: Merge objects
description: Merge objects using shallow or deep rules

title: Get value
description: Extract one value by path or a list of wildcard matches
hint: Supports dot paths, JSON Pointer, and * wildcards. Does not execute scripts.

title: Set defaults
description: Distinguish missing values, null, empty text, and empty lists

title: Convert type
description: Convert types explicitly; reject invalid numbers and implicit truthiness

title: Parse JSON text
description: Strictly parse JSON with optional schema validation

title: Generate JSON text
description: Serialize data as compact or indented JSON

title: Validate data
description: Validate against JSON Schema and return field diagnostics

title: Filter list
description: Filter list items with composable conditions

title: Map list
description: Map fields for each item without repeating downstream nodes

title: Sort list
description: Stable multi-field sorting with explicit null placement

title: Deduplicate list
description: Deduplicate by full values or field combinations while preserving order

fields.label: Comparison fields
fields.hint: Use dot paths for nested fields. Use JSON Pointer for field names containing dots.

title: Slice list
description: Select a range or the first or last items

title: Flatten list
description: Flatten nested lists to a bounded depth

title: Batch list
description: Split a list into fixed-size batches

title: Group list
description: Group by structured field combinations and preserve order within groups

fields.label: Group fields
fields.hint: Use dot paths for nested fields. Use JSON Pointer for field names containing dots.

title: Aggregate list
description: Group and calculate counts, sums, averages, and collected items

fields.label: Group fields
fields.hint: Use dot paths for nested fields. Use JSON Pointer for field names containing dots.

outputNotes: Each rows entry is {key: {<configured grouping path>: value}, <metric name>: value}. Group values are nested under row.key, not directly on row. Keep currency as a grouping key when aggregating money.

title: Concatenate lists
description: Concatenate at least two lists in input order

title: Join lists
description: Join two lists by key or position, keeping multiple matches

title: Set operations
description: Compute intersection, union, difference, or symmetric difference

fields.label: Comparison fields
fields.hint: Use dot paths for nested fields. Use JSON Pointer for field names containing dots.

title: Transform text
description: Trim, change case, replace, split, join, and slice

title: Regular expression
description: Extract capture groups, test, replace, or split text

fields.label: Flags
fields.hint: Available flags: i (case insensitive), m (multiline), s (dot matches newline), x (ignore pattern whitespace).

fields.label: Replacement template
fields.hint: Use ${1} or ${name} for capture groups, and $$ for a literal $.

title: Render text template
description: Generate text or HTML with variables, conditions, and loops

title: Math
description: Explicit numeric operations; reject division by zero and non-finite results

title: Date and time
description: Parse, format, convert time zones, and perform calendar operations

fields.label: Time zone
fields.hint: Use an IANA time zone, such as Asia/Shanghai. Ambiguous or nonexistent local times fail.

title: Encode or decode
description: Convert between UTF-8 text and Base64, URL, or Hex

title: Hash content
description: Compute SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 for UTF-8 text

title: Chunk text
description: Split by paragraphs, headings, or fixed character counts while retaining source positions
